# Emendo Consulting Group

> > Emendo Consulting Group provides digital transformation, process optimization, project management, and statistical consulting services for regulated industries including pharma, biotech, life sciences, and manufacturing.

Emendo specializes in GMP-compliant project delivery, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, PLM implementations, and Generative AI workshops tailored for regulated environments. The firm operates across Europe and the U.S., serving pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotech companies, MedTech firms, and consumer goods organizations.

## Key Topics

- GMP Compliance
- Digital Transformation
- Generative AI (GenAI)
- Lean Six Sigma
- Process Improvement
- Project Management Office (PMO)
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
- Technology Transfer (WHO Annex 7)
- Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
- Statistical Consulting (DOE, ICH)
- Regulatory Compliance
- Biotech
- Risk Management
- Data Mesh
- Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMO)
